lowpoly-dark-fantasy.label: Lowpoly dark fantasy
lowpoly-dark-fantasy.note: Five upright fighters. Scout stays the board mesh. Archers, the blob healer, the catapult crew, and flat props were not mapped.

woodland-folklore.label: Woodland folklore
woodland-folklore.note: Nothing selected. The set is dioramas and subjects that are not the labeled roles: houses, ponds, trees, and figures on plinths.

gothic-occult.label: Gothic occult
gothic-occult.note: Knight and heavy armor only. Cathedrals, coffins, and the witch labeled as a duelist were not mapped onto roles.

arcane-clockwork.label: Arcane clockwork
arcane-clockwork.note: Shield mech, duelist, staff caster, and shield brute. Slot 26 is a ground sheet and was not imported. The spider fodder sits on a wide base and was left out.

bioluminescent-alien.label: Bioluminescent alien
bioluminescent-alien.note: Shield warrior, beetle, and horned charger. Slots 5, 9, 19, 23, 24, 25, and 28 are generic humanoids and were not used. The jellyfish was not mapped onto a caster.
